confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge of São Paulo price levels, not checked against live menus or listings. Restaurant and bar anchors are moderately reliable; hostel and hotel anchors are less certain because they vary widely by neighbourhood (Paulista, Jardins, Centro, Vila Mariana), season and booking lead time. Cocktail and wine anchors are weaker and were set relative to draft beer and the midrange meal, since direct knowledge of those prices is limited. July is in Brazil's dry winter season, which is not a peak or off-peak month for São Paulo, so no seasonal adjustment was applied beyond typical mid-year demand. Accommodation figures assume taxes and mandatory service fees are included.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other large Latin American metropolises with comparable mid-range restaurant and hotel pricing (for example Mexico City and Buenos Aires for the restaurant and hotel tiers), adjusted for São Paulo's relatively high hotel and dining costs compared with budget-oriented Latin American cities.
